mintAuthority.summary: Movement USDCx is an inherited Circle USDC representation, not an independently canonical Movement-native issuance deployment. The Movement token object requires xReserve-signed messages and exposes no permissionless local free-mint path. Its xReserve attester, Movement attester, admin, pause, route-policy, and compatible package-upgrade powers are bridge capabilities preserved in structured Bridge Risk controls.

review.evidence: At Movement ledger version 220370475 and block height 97379184, token resources identify package 0x4989d2b05833820092401455cb689460b861e7f34b761f58b07a4910bd847f83, two attesters, domain 10005, and the admin account 0x98ebb7985c84a89972022edf391bdaa7d95f061d9742efb3703de368413431e1. The actual package exposes a signed-message mint entry and has compatible upgrade policy 1 at upgrade_number 0, with published source and source_digest 780F94E9BB25259CB190418FB9D76BE1CBC8E0DB4353BD8E671A3456CF4E864B. The current admin/package owner is 3-of-6, superseding historical 4-of-6 evidence; these are bridge-representation capabilities retained under Bridge Risk. Source publication is not independent bytecode equivalence proof. Circle's documentation describes remote tokens backed by deposited USDC and verified deposit/burn attestations; the no-local-issuance boundary is unchanged.

noLocalIssuance.rationale: The only authored USDCx deployment is the Movement representation of Circle USDC through xReserve; Ethereum USDC is the inherited canonical collateral and no independent Movement-native USDCx liability path is claimed.
